# Mahdev (Pvt) Ltd

> Mahdev is a Sri Lankan company bringing together event production, photography and cinema, technology, travel, and online retail.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://mahdev-official.vercel.app/): Overview of Mahdev and its divisions.
- [About Mahdev](https://mahdev-official.vercel.app/about): Company background and information.
- [Services](https://mahdev-official.vercel.app/services): Services available across Mahdev.
- [Projects](https://mahdev-official.vercel.app/portfolio): Selected projects and work.
- [Gallery](https://mahdev-official.vercel.app/gallery): Photography and visual work.
- [Careers](https://mahdev-official.vercel.app/careers): Current career opportunities.
- [Contact](https://mahdev-official.vercel.app/contact): Contact and enquiry information.
- [Insights](https://mahdev-official.vercel.app/insights): Company articles and insights.

## Divisions

- [SWS Event Management](https://mahdev-official.vercel.app/sws): Event production and management.
- [U1 Studio](https://mahdev-official.vercel.app/u1): Photography, cinema, and creative studio services.
- [Mahdev IT](https://mahdev-official.vercel.app/it): IT and digital solutions.
- [Mahdev Travels](https://mahdev-official.vercel.app/travels): Travel planning and experiences.
- [Mahdev Online Mart](https://mahdev-official.vercel.app/mart): Online retail and equipment.
